title: Foam Sound Test 🔊
description:
Original Video Credit: IG/acousticpro_

Two different foam panels are placed in front of the same studio monitor to compare how they affect the sound. While both are commonly associated with audio treatment, the difference in what you hear is immediate.

The pyramid acoustic foam is designed to absorb sound reflections and reduce echo inside a room, not stop sound from passing through it. The rebonded foam is much denser, giving it far greater resistance to sound transmission and noticeably reducing the amount of noise that reaches the other side.

Understanding the difference between acoustic treatment and sound isolation is essential when building a studio, home theater, or recording space. Choosing the right material depends on whether you're trying to improve the sound within a room or prevent it from traveling beyond it.
